source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The desktop builder now declares -L as a JSON encoded list and calls json.loads. The repack callers pass DESKTOP_LOCALES correctly, but its module usage example still passes a shipped-locales filename. Manual documentation proposal: update the example when an argument changes from a path to serialized data. This is a verified source discrepancy. It is not evidence that the current repack callers fail. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Keep command examples consistent with changed argument types
